parsed.why: Significant sensor anomalies well exceeding threshold limits are observed across multiple distinct tool hardware subsystems, including the coolant circuit (FLOWCOOLFLOWRATE, FLOWCOOLPRESSURE), chamber vacuum (IONGAUGEPRESSURE), and the ion beam power delivery stack (ETCHBEAMVOLTAGE, ETCHBEAMCURRENT, ETCHSUPPRESSORVOLTAGE), while only ETCHSUPPRESSORCURRENT remained normal. Concurrent severe deviations across independent physical domains rule out single-sensor instrumentation error and point to an integrated equipment failure (e.g., chiller/coolant loop failure propagating into thermal and beam instability), requiring physical component inspection.
